summary: OpenAI's CEO announced the full release of GPT-5.5-Cyber, stated to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the CyberGym benchmark, alongside Patch The Planet and Codex Security tools aimed at fixing rather than just finding security vulnerabilities.

mechanisms.reason: The post claims a shift from detecting to autonomously solving security problems, a potential task-class step change, but gives no detail on how this works.
mechanisms.quote: Patch The Planet and Codex Security will help solve security problems instead of just finding them.

practices.reason: A security-specialized model variant claiming SOTA benchmark performance is worth evaluating for automated vulnerability remediation workflows, but the post gives no methodology or replicable detail.
practices.quote: The full version of GPT-5.5-Cyber is here; state of the art performance on CyberGym.

practices.reason: CyberGym is cited as the benchmark behind the SOTA claim, but no methodology or comparative numbers are given to assess or replicate.
practices.quote: state of the art performance on CyberGym.
